name: Liz O'Neill
title: Counsellor (ACA registered)
description: A queer counsellor in Naarm (Melbourne) offering online support. LGBTQIA+ affirming and inclusive; trauma-informed and strengths-based, supporting LGBTQIA+ identity, relationships and life experiences, and trauma and difficult life experiences.

name: Lua (Calm Centre Therapy)
title: Therapist

name: Paul Byrne
title: Psychologist

title: ACA Accredited Psychotherapist

specialties: LGBTQIA+, gender-affirming, trauma, childhood trauma, addiction
identity: South Asian; LGBTIQ owned and operated

name: Maks Steszewski
title: Psychotherapist (PACFA registered)

identity: grew up queer in a migrant family

name: Alicia Shevlin
title: Psychologist
description: LGBTQIA+ affirming psychological support for adults; experienced in providing therapeutic support to those in the transgender community and working with single-incident or complex trauma within a psychodynamic framework.

name: Unison Mental Health (Marissa Guild)
title: Clinical Psychology / Psychotherapist / Sex Therapist team
description: Affirming, evidence-based therapy for individuals, couples, and diverse relationship structures. Our practice is sex-positive, kink-aware, and sex-worker-affirming, supporting LGBTQIA+ communities and polyamory/ENM.
specialties: trauma, CPTSD, EMDR, Schema, IFS, sex therapy, kink-aware, sex-positive, LGBTQIA+, polyamory
